summary: Remove private deployment details from website contributor files and add a public-source regression check. API impact: none — no runtime behavior changes.

guide.reason: Contributor-source privacy cleanup does not change operator workflows or the served website.

api.reason: Only README, ignore rules and a local regression check change; no client-facing API, Controller operation or Core command/result is affected.

state.reason: Website source, hosting and review only; no Nex Controller or Core state.

verification.method: Enumerate Git-visible website files; inspect source/lockfile, screenshots and metadata; reproduce README disclosure with failing regression, then pass both checks after cleanup; inspect ignore behavior and obtain independent review. See report for actual scope and limits.
